summary: IRGC Brigadier General Hossein Zarefi and an intelligence officer were killed in an armed clash in Saravan, Iran, with at least 13 other security personnel severely wounded. A cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile, caught fire, and left adrift with two crew injured, amid declining maritime traffic through the strait. The IDF announced imminent strikes in Lebanon while a car-ramming attack at Maccabim checkpoint critically wounded an Israeli reserve soldier, and a tunnel with weapons was uncovered in Qalqilya.
key_points: IRGC Brigadier General Hossein Zarefi, operational commander of the Sajjad base in Saravan, was killed in a clash with armed individuals that also killed intelligence officer Ahmad Herati Zarai and severely wounded at least 13 other personnel. (Source: @VahidOnline/78504)

The UKMTO reported an attack on the cargo ship MV Cape Dao in the Strait of Hormuz by an unknown projectile, causing a fire and leaving the vessel adrift with two crew members injured. (Source: @mamlekate/104598)

The IDF informed residents of Kiryat Shmona and the Galilee that a wave of strikes in Lebanon would be conducted in the coming hours, with possible explosions heard. (Source: @New_security8200/203905)
Israeli security forces discovered a tunnel at least 25 meters deep in Qalqilya, West Bank, seizing a sniper rifle, M16, ammunition, and fertilizer for explosives. (Source: @yediotnews25/135291)

A car-ramming attack at the Maccabim checkpoint in the Benjamin Brigade area critically wounded an IDF reserve soldier, who remains in life-threatening condition. (Source: @pkpoi/144046, @N12chat/226824)

Iranian Major General Safavi stated that Iran is prepared for a new phase of potential war with the US, with scenarios drafted for a wider front extending from the Persian Gulf and Red Sea to the Indian Ocean. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91429)

The Israeli Navy is set to receive its sixth submarine, INS Drakon, a 74-meter, 2,600-ton Dolphin 2-class vessel, as part of a plan to expand the fleet amid threats in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb. (Source: @manniefabian/59224)
The UAE Central Bank sanctioned the National Bank of Iran, barring its UAE branches from financial transactions with Iran over regulatory non-compliance. (Source: @mamlekate/104597)

sections.executive_summary: IRGC Brigadier General Hossein Zarefi and intelligence officer Ahmad Herati Zarai were killed in a Saravan clash with 13 other personnel severely wounded, marking a significant loss for Iran's southeastern security apparatus. The MV Cape Dao was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz by an unknown projectile, causing fire and drift with two injured, while ship traffic through the strait has declined sharply. The IDF declared imminent strikes in Lebanon, a car-ramming at Maccabim checkpoint critically wounded a reservist, and a 25-meter-deep tunnel with weapons was found in Qalqilya.

points: IRGC Quds Force Ground Forces confirmed Brigadier General Hossein Zarefi, operational commander of the Sajjad base in Saravan, Sistan-Baluchestan, was killed in an armed clash with armed individuals in the Jihadabad area on 1 Mehr; intelligence officer Ahmad Herati Zarai was also killed and at least 13 other military and security personnel severely wounded. (Source: @VahidOnline/78504)

Senior advisor to the Supreme Leader Major General Safavi declared Iran ready for a new phase of potential war with the United States, stating armed forces have drafted worst-case scenarios and that any renewed attack would widen the war front from the Persian Gulf and Red Sea to the Indian Ocean or beyond. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91429)

Iran's Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces praised President Pezeshkian's UN General Assembly address as the 'resounding voice of the proud Iranian nation,' emphasizing Iran's right to defend its independence and territorial integrity. (Source: @presstv/208044, @rasedal3ado138e/394453)

Former Foreign Minister Zarif responded to Trump's threats against Iran, stating the US mistakenly treats the UN General Assembly as a battlefield and warning that threatening the Iranian people will not succeed; Iran remains ready for diplomacy but will not tolerate threats. (Source: @SharghDaily/185495)
The Iraqi flag was flown during 'Fedayeen Iran' maneuvers in Iran's Khuzestan province, signaling continued military cooperation between Iran and Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91428)

The UAE Central Bank sanctioned the National Bank of Iran for non-compliance with sanctions regulations, barring its UAE branches from conducting financial transactions with Iran after supervisory inspections. (Source: @mamlekate/104597)

The IDF announced a wave of strikes in Lebanon to be conducted in the coming hours, warning residents of Kiryat Shmona and the Galilee that explosions may be heard while routine continues with no special instructions. (Source: @New_security8200/203905)

A car-ramming attack at the Maccabim checkpoint in the Benjamin Brigade area critically wounded an IDF reserve soldier; the victim, Neria Leiter, remains in life-threatening condition after surgeries at Shaare Zedek hospital. (Source: @pkpoi/144046, @N12chat/226824, @almogboker78/18258)

IDF forces from Yahalom and Nahal Reconnaissance under the Shomron Brigade demolished the home of the terrorist who murdered Yehuda Sherman in Beit Ammar village on March 21, 2026, in a nighttime operation. (Source: @idf_telegram/25193)

The Israeli Navy is set to receive its sixth submarine, INS Drakon, a 74-meter, 2,600-ton Dolphin 2-class vessel after a 3,792-nautical-mile voyage from Germany; the navy plans five Reshef-class corvettes in 3-4 years to counter threats in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb. (Source: @manniefabian/59224)

Prime Minister Netanyahu is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly at 21:00 Israel time, with planned meetings with the presidents of Argentina and other leaders. (Source: @New_security8200/203919)

Former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett called for Qatar to be declared an enemy state, accusing it of funding Hamas, hosting its leadership, and spreading antisemitic propaganda; he pledged cross-party support for such a designation. (Source: @yediotnews25/135284)

Hostile warplanes were reported flying over northern occupied Palestine (Israel), prompting Lebanese internal security to request immediate reporting of any hostile drone or warplane activity via dedicated bots. (Source: @redlinkleb/44648, @redlinkleb/44634)

Israeli anti-crime unit and Magav Yehuda forces uncovered a tunnel at least 25 meters deep in Qalqilya, West Bank, 10 minutes from Hod Hasharon, seizing a sniper rifle, M16, ammunition, and fertilizer used for explosives. (Source: @yediotnews25/135291)

A car-ramming attack at the Maccabim checkpoint critically wounded an IDF reserve soldier; the attacker's identity and fate were not specified in the messages. (Source: @pkpoi/144046, @almogboker78/18244)

IDF demolished the house of the terrorist responsible for the March 21, 2026 murder of Yehuda Sherman in Beit Ammar village, conducted by Yahalom and Nahal Reconnaissance units. (Source: @idf_telegram/25193)

The IDF Chief of Staff referenced the Maccabim checkpoint attack during a memorial ceremony, vowing to continue acting decisively to suppress terror organizations and ensure security. (Source: @idf_telegram/25189)

The IDF declared imminent strikes in Lebanon, advising Kiryat Shmona and Galilee residents of possible explosions while maintaining routine with no special instructions. (Source: @New_security8200/203905)
Artillery shelling was reported in Meidoun, Lebanon, with a live map reference provided. (Source: @redlinkleb/44638)
Artillery shelling was reported in Zoutar al-Sharqiya, Lebanon, with a live map reference provided. (Source: @redlinkleb/44632)
